overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF (RVNL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Rivian Automotive stock. RVNL was launched on Apr 21, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
